connector.name: Nexatron
connector.registryDescription: Ask your enterprise data in plain English. Governed analytics over MCP, from dotSolved.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.nexatron.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package nexatron-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sravanmodugula-solved account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEXATRON_API_KEY
env.description: Nexatron API key starting with `nxa_`. Mint in the Nexatron app under Settings -> API Keys.

env.name: NEXATRON_URL
env.description: Nexatron API base URL. Defaults to https://api.nexatron.io/api/v1. Override for self-hosted or staging environments.
